title: Staodio
tagline: Staodi is from studio + DAO. Aim to matching between creator and investor. We offer DAO for manage NFTs minting process from start to end.
description: The project offer DAO for creator and investor to manage NFTs project, they can propose ERC721 parameters such as totalSupply, price, when it start and when it end. Aim to make the creator has funds to create NFTs before start project and investor can get sharing profit from NFTs that sell from creator.
how_its_made: We used ZoraNFTCreator for create NFTs from our DAO deploying to polygon mainnet. Using hardhat for deploying our Staodio DAO template. On client side we use nextjs as frontend framework and wagmi for interacting out smart contract and rainbow-kit fro wallet connect all frontend using typescript.
